title: Return, ii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Tuesday. The comments. Nobody forgot the helicopter. Wood reads them at the motel desk at 3 AM with the pup asleep in the in-tray. The hum line.

panels.composition: The motel desk, 3 AM. WOOD with a laptop. BARNABY II, ten months, asleep in the desk's in-tray. The hum line.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a motel night clerk reading a laptop at 3 AM with a small three-legged puppy asleep in the desk's plastic in-tray, a flat line beneath the panel

panels.composition: The screen: comments under the return strip. 'HELICOPTER GUY IS BACK.' 'lol rolfcoptr.' 'wait where's the dog.' 'oh no. oh no.'

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a laptop screen showing a column of short comments beneath a comic strip
image.notes: Letter after: HELICOPTER GUY IS BACK · lol rolfcoptr · wait where's the dog · oh no. oh no.

panels.composition: Wood reading the last two. Looking at the in-tray.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a clerk looking from a laptop screen to a puppy asleep in an in-tray, no words

panels.composition: Wood typing one reply — the strip's first ever. Four words. The screen: 'He's in the tray.' The hum line.
props: the reply: He's in the tray.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a clerk typing a very short reply on a laptop at a motel desk at night, a flat line beneath the panel
image.notes: Letter after: He's in the tray. The strip's only comment reply.

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: 'wait where's the dog.' 'He's in the tray.' The only reply.
